briefing: The market had a risk-off day: the NASDAQ fell 1.6% and the S&P 500 fell 0.9%, so the screener returned no buy candidates. Cash is $445.88, which is under the $500 buy threshold, so we are holding all 7 positions and not opening anything new. The automatic -7% stop-losses and +12% profit targets stay in place to manage risk on what we already own.

daily_lesson.explanation_en: A 'risk-off' day is when investors sell riskier assets like fast-growing tech stocks and move into safer ones, so the market falls. Experienced traders often stop opening new positions on these days, because buying into falling prices can mean catching a stock that keeps dropping. Holding cash and waiting for a better entry is a valid choice, not a missed opportunity.
daily_lesson.explanation_zh: 「避險模式」（Risk-Off）是指投資者拋售高風險資產，例如高速增長的科技股，轉投較安全的資產，令大市下跌。在這種日子，有經驗的交易員往往暫停開新倉，因為在跌勢中買入，可能會接到一隻繼續下跌的股票。持有現金、耐心等待更好的入市時機，本身就是合理的選擇，並非錯失機會。

market_education.summary_en: US stocks fell broadly today. Tech-heavy names were hit hardest: the NASDAQ dropped 1.6%, compared with 0.9% for the wider S&P 500. When the NASDAQ falls more than the S&P 500, it usually means investors are pulling back from higher-risk growth stocks, but no news headlines came with today's data, so we can't name the specific cause.
market_education.summary_zh: 美股今日普遍回落，科技股跌幅最大，納斯達克指數下跌1.6%，標普500指數則下跌0.9%。納指跌幅大於標普500，通常反映資金正撤出風險較高的增長股。由於今日數據未附新聞標題，我們未能確認觸發這次下跌的具體原因。
